hero_title: Media Strategy Tailored for Attorneys and Legal Organizations
hero_body: Kandel Strategies helps law firms share their expertise with reporters when it can add something useful to a story. Founded by former journalist Jason Kandel, the firm gets to know what attorneys do best, researches where their perspective may fit, and manages outreach to pursue earned media coverage. Kandel Strategies is also developing roadmaps to help firms present their expertise clearly and back it up with evidence, including for people using AI to research legal help.
philosophy_quote: Kandel Strategies emphasizes authentic credibility, direct communication, and thorough groundwork over generic PR scripts or high-volume promotional noise. The firm combines veteran journalism experience with modern digital tools to deliver clear, factual media strategies for law firms, legal leaders, and corporate executives.
services_header: Core Practice Areas: Legal PR, Media Relations & AI Visibility

services.title: Legal PR
services.description: Clear, focused messaging that turns complex matters into jargon-free language and creates opportunities for attorneys and executives to share their expertise.

services.title: Media Relations
services.description: Direct outreach to reporters and newsrooms to secure earned coverage in mainstream media and legal trades.

services.title: AI Visibility
services.description: Structuring your public record, published work, and media coverage so tools such as Google AI Overviews and Gemini, ChatGPT, and Claude cite your expertise accurately.

about_text: Jason Kandel is a legal PR strategist and former journalist, serving as the founder and principal of Kandel Strategies. He draws on over two decades of newsroom experience, including reporting for the Los Angeles Times, Thomson Reuters, NBC4 Los Angeles, and LAist/KPCC, to manage high-stakes legal PR and strategic media outreach.

faqs.question: What services does Kandel Strategies provide?
faqs.answer: Kandel Strategies provides legal PR, strategic media relations, and AI visibility tailored specifically for law firms, corporate legal departments, and executives.

faqs.question: How does Kandel Strategies assist with legal PR?
faqs.answer: Kandel Strategies manages press coverage during active litigation and court proceedings. The firm drafts official statements, prepares trial attorneys for reporter interviews, and handles newsroom inquiries to protect client reputations and ensure accurate coverage during high-profile legal disputes.

faqs.question: What types of legal matters does Kandel Strategies provide media strategy for?
faqs.answer: We provide legal PR and strategic media strategy for high-stakes legal disputes, including commercial litigation, intellectual property disputes, entertainment and sports matters, white-collar defense, employment suits, and regulatory investigations.

faqs.question: How does Kandel Strategies work with clients?
faqs.answer: We offer flexible engagement options tailored to legal matters, including ongoing monthly retainers for firm-wide media strategy and project-based support for active litigation.

faqs.question: Where is Kandel Strategies located and who do you serve?
faqs.answer: Based in Southern California, Kandel Strategies serves law firms, corporate legal departments, and individual attorneys across California and nationwide.

faqs.question: How can I schedule a consultation with Kandel Strategies?
faqs.answer: You can schedule a confidential consultation by using the contact form on our website or emailing jason@kandelstrategies.com. We provide same-day responses for urgent litigation and crisis inquiries.
